reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of Hydration HOLLAR docs: HOLLAR is GHO-style overcollateralized mint against crypto collateral including DOT, ETH, vDOT, USDT, USDC, tBTC, WBTC, plus HOLLAR Stability Module. Borrow markets app URL still live. No public per-asset weight table; envelope remains 100% aggregate borrow-market/HSM collateral with ku=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Hydration's documented HOLLAR collateral set; current per-asset and HSM-versus-borrow-market weights are unpublished
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current per-asset collateral weights, the share held via the HOLLAR Stability Module versus borrow positions, and per-asset utilization are not published as a dated aggregate.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held in on-chain borrow-market and HSM contracts on the Hydration appchain with automated per-block partial liquidations rather than a conventional custodian. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation concepts do not map to this non-custodial structure; operative risks are runtime governance and smart-contract integrity.
